title: God Has Kept Every Promise
story:
An elderly man had promised his grandson that he would take him fishing when the school holidays began.

The boy was excited and counted the days until the holiday arrived.

On the morning they had planned to go, heavy rain began to fall.

The boy thought the trip would have to be cancelled and felt disappointed.

But his grandfather had already prepared a small covered place near the lake where they could safely fish.

The boy was happy because his grandfather had remembered his promise and found a way to keep it.

As the years passed, the boy learned that his grandfather was someone whose word could always be trusted.

God is even more faithful than the most trustworthy person we know.

At the end of Joshua's life, Joshua reminded God's people that God had been faithful to them.

Every good promise God had made to Israel had been fulfilled. Not one of His promises had failed.

We also experience seasons when we wonder whether God's promises will really come true.

We may pray for something for a long time without seeing an answer. We may face circumstances that make us question what God is doing.

But God's faithfulness does not depend on our circumstances.

He keeps His word even when we cannot yet see how His promises will be fulfilled.

Our responsibility is to remember what God has already done, trust His character, and continue walking faithfully with Him.

When you face uncertainty, look back at God's faithfulness instead of focusing only on what you cannot see.

The God who kept His promises in the past is still faithful today.

You can trust Him with your future because not one of His good promises will fail.
life_lesson: God is completely faithful. Even when you cannot see how His promises will be fulfilled, remember what He has already done and continue trusting Him.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You because You are faithful and Your promises never fail.

Help me remember all the ways You have guided, protected, and provided for me.

When I face uncertainty and cannot understand what You are doing, help me trust Your faithfulness.

Keep me from becoming discouraged when answers to my prayers seem delayed.

Give me patience to wait for Your timing and faith to continue walking in Your ways.

Help me remember Your past faithfulness whenever I become afraid about the future.

Teach me to stand firmly on Your promises and to trust Your character even when circumstances are difficult.

Thank You that every good promise You have made can be trusted.

May my life remain faithful to You because You have always been faithful to me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there a promise of God that you are struggling to trust right now?

Can you remember a time when God answered a prayer or helped you through a difficult situation?

How can remembering God's past faithfulness strengthen your faith today?
verse: Not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.
